We generally target liquidity levels to support at least twelve months of our expected net cash outflows, including new originations, without access to our Corporate financing facility or equity markets.

In November 2023, we entered into a forward flow whole loan sale agreement with an institutional investor, under which we expect to sell approximately $100 million of our secured and unsecured personal loans in fiscal year 2026, subject to certain eligibility criteria.

Under the agreement, Column may originate certain unsecured personal loans for consumers in select states, and we will provide the platform and related services, including marketing, application processing, fraud-prevention, servicing and program-administration services, subject to Column’s oversight and control and compliance with applicable law.
We may require additional capital beyond our currently anticipated amounts and additional capital may not be available on reasonable terms, or at all.

statements.t: Our results outperformed our guidance for revenue, Adjusted EBITDA and net charge-offs.”
“Given our third-quarter performance and outlook for the fourth quarter, we are raising our full-year revenue and earnings outlook and lowering expected credit losses.

We now expect total revenue of $955 to $960 million, an Annualized Net Charge-Off Rate of 11.6% plus or minus 10 basis points, and Adjusted EPS of $1.60 to $1.70, reflecting 21% year-over-year growth at the midpoint.”

Management continues to expect to grow originations in the mid-single-digits range this year, yet now expects that growth to be on the higher end of that range, while remaining in a tight credit posture.
